notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register entry, one one-line cabin note, and a 1933 panorama credit. The 1920s build and 1940s loss are decade-only; the 1920 and 1940 years in events are placeholders, not dates from a source. The brief's coordinates (N 45.335951, W 121.611463) match the register; firelookout.com's index lists 45.33579, -121.61127, a small difference. The brief lists the site as kind ground and status gone; the register's wording supports that. Do not confuse with Elk Mountain in Coos County (US 793) or the Wallowa County Elk Mountain (US 1614). No photo of current condition found; no access information found.
